falsifiable_hypothesis: The targetwise reliability r_j=max(0,1-v_j/d_j^2) is a variance-reliability fraction. Hierarchical contrast correction acts on amplitude, so sqrt(r_j) is the natural amplitude reliability. Adding independent common-mode and global-vector James-Stein reliabilities and saturating at one can preserve reliable target corrections while retaining whole-vector stability.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
shrinkage_rule: From the same three authenticated inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF contrast vectors compute theta_global, theta_hier, global reliability a_global, common-mode reliability a_common, deviation mean d_j and variance-of-mean v_j. Define r_j=max(0,1-v_j/d_j^2), with r_j=0 when d_j^2 is numerically zero. Set w_j=min(1,sqrt(r_j)+a_common+a_global), theta_j=theta_global,j+w_j*(theta_hier,j-theta_global,j), and q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta. There is no weight menu, target/fold outer routing, or protected data.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
